content: sarim/goibus: existing Go implementation of libibus proving IBus engines in Go via godbus (cgo optional via _common.cgo, pure-Go common.go path exists). Pattern: NewBus = dbus.Dial(GetAddress()) + conn.Auth(GetUserAuth()) + conn.Hello(); RegisterComponent(dbus.MakeVariant(component)); Factory exported at /org/freedesktop/IBus/Factory, method CreateEngine(engineName string) (dbus.ObjectPath, *dbus.Error); engine exported via conn.Export(obj, path, org.freedesktop.IBus.Engine), ProcessKeyEvent(keyval,keycode,state uint32)(bool,*dbus.Error); Component/EngineDesc marshal as D-Bus structs inside a variant; GetAddress reads IBUS_ADDRESS env then ~/.config/ibus/bus address files.
